The application is built, verified, and ready for your review.

## What I built
The real application (not the prototype) now lives as a full web app with your **one private, signed-in collection stored on the server** so it's the same on any device. It implements everything we approved — quick saving with auto-filled details, editing with notes/tags, read-later, the full search language, click-a-tag filtering, sorting, archive, confirmed delete, bulk actions, live saved collections, **real automatic preserved copies** (the actual PDF for PDF links) with failure+retry, an optional per-bookmark Internet Archive copy, browser-bookmark import/export, and personal settings.

## Verification results (plain language)
- **Automated behavior tests: 23/23 passed** — covering saving & duplicates, editing & the address-conflict guard, read-later, the search language, archive/restore, confirmed delete, bulk actions, saved collections, preserved copies (including a real PDF captured and stored), import/export (folders→tags, dates kept, duplicates skipped), sign-in, and settings.
- **End-to-end tests driving the actual screens in a browser: 19/19 passed** — login, importing a bookmarks file, saving a live link with auto-filled title, a preserved copy being captured, tag search, sorting, read-later, archive/restore, saving & opening a collection, bulk tagging, delete-with-confirmation, and settings persisting after reload.
- I confirmed **live** that page details are fetched, that a preserved copy is really captured and can be reopened, and that your settings survive a reload. Where a page or the Internet Archive can't be reached, it degrades exactly as we agreed (bookmark still saved; clear, retryable failure).

## How to review it
**Open [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000)** and sign in:
- **Email:** `me@bookmarks.local`
- **Password:** `bookmarks`

You'll start with an empty collection. Try pasting a real link (e.g. `https://github.com`) — details auto-fill and a preserved copy is captured a moment later (watch the "Saving copy…" → "🗎 Saved copy" badge). Then explore Edit, tags, the search box, the tabs, Select, ⚙ Settings, and Import/Export. Everything you approved is there.

## One honest note
Preserved-copy capture and the Internet Archive save depend on the target page/service being reachable from the server; in our checks the network was available and captures succeeded, and failures are handled gracefully when it isn't.

**Do you accept this software as complete for this cycle**, on the basis of the behavior we approved and the verification above? If anything doesn't match an approved behavior, tell me and I'll correct it within this cycle; anything that changes or adds to the approved scope I'll record for a later round.
